decisions.reason: As a flagship organic salami line with several variants that sits squarely in the firm's salami and organic know-how, it matches existing absorptive capacity and is more likely to be refined than withdrawn.
This premium sharing salami snack remains close to the firm's core competencies, and after surviving its first year the firm can use market feedback to adjust the line rather than exit it.
Organic boiled pork sausage extends a very familiar product type for the firm and fits the organic assortment strategy, so the firm has the knowledge base to support and improve it commercially.

Organic thinly sliced chicken breast is still within the firm's cold-cut and organic capabilities, but as a somewhat more adjacent poultry offering and a newer multi-variant line it faces a bit more portfolio risk than the core salami items.

Organic herb-coated salami is highly related to the firm's salami expertise, yet as a newer and more niche flavor-specific variant it is somewhat more exposed to SKU rationalisation if uptake is weaker than expected.
